project_type: Kubernetes-deployed FastAPI service template (PostgreSQL + Redis). Pure template: identity/ARN/storage values are PLACEHOLDER_* tokens so it builds before init. This batch is the THIRD on branch main, after (1) Argo CD + SOPS->Secrets-Manager->ESO and (2) a PROJECT_SLUG placeholder-coverage expansion.
language: Python 3.13 (pinned in .python-version); YAML Kubernetes manifests (kustomize base + dev/prod overlays + deploy/argocd); GitHub Actions workflows.
build_system: uv (pyproject.toml + committed uv.lock). Tasks via poethepoet: `uv run poe <task>`. Add deps ONLY with `uv add`/`uv add --dev`; NEVER hand-edit uv.lock; NEVER pip install. Kustomize is `kubectl kustomize` (no standalone binary). mkdocs runs via uvx (pinned mkdocs==1.6.1 + mkdocs-material==9.7.7).
test_framework: pytest (+ pytest-asyncio, httpx). Unit tests in tests/unit/ MUST run with NO services. Integration tests marked @pytest.mark.integration need Postgres+Redis (tests/integration/).
build_command: uv run poe check  (ruff lint + mypy --strict + pytest unit)
test_command: uv run poe test  (pytest); full gate: uv run poe check-all (lint, typecheck, audit, security, test, k8s-check, docs-build)
verification_instructions: From repo root: (1) `uv run poe check` = ruff lint + mypy --strict + unit tests (no services). (2) `uv run poe k8s-check` renders deploy/k8s/overlays/{dev,prod} + deploy/argocd, runs kubeconform TWICE — pass (a) lenient (-ignore-missing-schemas + -schema-location default + the vendored-dir template), pass (b) scoped to the CRD-bearing renders with -ignore-missing-schemas REMOVED and -schema-location pointing ONLY at deploy/k8s/crd-schemas (core kinds -skip'd), so an unresolved CNPG/Redis/ESO/Argo CR FAILS the build; then kube-linter on dev/prod only. (3) `uv run poe security` = gitleaks + ruff S + scripts/check_sops_encrypted.py. (4) `uv run poe docs-build` = mkdocs build --strict. (5) `rg PLACEHOLDER_` must list only intended tokens. (6) actionlint is NOT installed locally — validate .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml with `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml'))"` then `pre-commit run check-yaml --files .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml`. RECORD the exact commands + results in commit messages / a verification note so the reviewer reads the evidence without re-running.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock is generated by `uv add`/`uv lock` and committed — do not hand-edit; run `uv lock` if pyproject deps change (this task adds no runtime deps). No other generated/snapshot files.
environment_constraints: No worktree: work on branch main in repo ROOT. kubectl, kubeconform (CI pins 0.8.0 — NO toLower template func, so vendored schema filenames MUST use canonical kind casing), kube-linter (CI pins 0.8.3), yq (mikefarah), sops, uv are available locally. actionlint is NOT installed locally. CNPG, the Spotahome Redis operator, Argo CD, and ESO are ASSUMED pre-installed cluster-side (like the Datadog Agent) — this repo ships only the CRs, never the operators. Conventional Commits enforced by the commit-msg hook (feeds git-cliff). Commit locally; never push. Stage specific files (NOT git add -A); NO --no-verify; prefer new commits over --amend.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md + SPEC.md §14: SPEC.md is source of truth — this batch reverses the §2 managed-DB/cache non-goal and records it by editing docs/adr/0001-technology-choices.md IN PLACE (NO new ADR). Use poe tasks, not raw tools (local==CI). mypy --strict for new Python; no blanket `# type: ignore` (each needs an error code + reason). Never commit plaintext secrets; only SOPS-encrypted deploy/**/secrets.*.yaml; examples use PLACEHOLDER_* only. Security suppressions (`# noqa: S...`, kube-linter excludes) need a written reason on the same line / in the ignore file. New template values are PLACEHOLDER_<NAME> tokens registered in .template/placeholders.yml and kept as valid strings. Pydantic models stay the only request/response types.
key_patterns: CNPG Cluster is named `pg` -> Services pg-rw (primary, writes+migrations), pg-ro, pg-r. Cluster OMITS spec.bootstrap.initdb.secret so CNPG GENERATES the app-role Secret `pg-app` (type basic-auth, keys username/password/host/port/dbname/uri/jdbc-uri/pgpass) — the app consumes the DISCRETE keys (NOT uri; uri can carry libpq sslmode= which asyncpg rejects as `connect() got an unexpected keyword argument 'sslmode'`). deployment.yaml + migration-job.yaml project host/port/username/password/dbname as env PG_HOST/PG_PORT/PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD/PG_DBNAME via secretKeyRef:{name: pg-app}; app-secrets envFrom STAYS (now carries REDIS_PASSWORD). config.Settings composes database_dsn (postgresql+asyncpg://, BOTH user+password percent-quoted, NO query string) from DATABASE_URL locally OR the full PG_* set in-cluster; a model_validator requires exactly one DB mode AND one Redis mode (fatal at startup otherwise). db.create_engine normalizes postgresql://->postgresql+asyncpg:// and rejects ONLY libpq-only query keys {sslmode,sslrootcert,sslcert,sslkey,sslpassword,gssencmode,sslnegotiation} by name — NOT a blanket `?` ban. Redis: RedisFailover (databases.spotahome.com/v1) named `redis`, 3 sentinels + 3 redis; operator reads key `password` from the Secret in spec.auth.secretPath (app-secrets); ESO materializes BOTH `REDIS_PASSWORD` (app) and `password` (operator) from the ONE Secrets Manager property REDIS_PASSWORD via an explicit two-entry data: block (not dataFrom.extract). App connects to sentinels via Sentinel(hosts, sentinel_kwargs={password}, password=, decode_responses=True).master_for('mymaster'); REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS (rfs-redis:26379) + REDIS_MASTER_NAME (mymaster) are non-secret -> base ConfigMap; both overlays are Sentinel-mode; ConfigMap/app-secrets carry NO REDIS_URL in-cluster. health.py + items.py are UNTOUCHED (master_for client get/set/delete/ping identical). migrations/env.py get_url() returns Settings().database_dsn (was .database_url) — HIGH: without this the PreSync hook breaks in-cluster and mypy --strict fails. kubeconform schema-location template `{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json` OMITS the API group (kind+version unique); vendored files: Cluster_v1.json, ScheduledBackup_v1.json, Backup_v1.json, RedisFailover_v1.json (canonical casing). Pass (b) auto-enforces them once the files exist (no -skip change needed except dropping the dead CronJob entry). CNPG ScheduledBackup schedule is a 6-FIELD (seconds-first) cron ('0 0 3 * * *' = 03:00:00 UTC) — comment it so nobody 'normalizes' to 5 fields. ScheduledBackup Barman destinationPath carries PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_PREFIX in base; each overlay MANDATORILY patches the Cluster barmanObjectStore destinationPath/serverName to dev/prod (distinct prefixes, like the old BACKUP_PREFIX patch). Backup IRSA moves from the deleted backup SA to the Cluster serviceAccountTemplate annotation. NetworkPolicy podSelector matches app.kubernetes.io/name:<slug>; CNPG/RedisFailover pods are operator-labeled, NOT slug-labeled, so this policy never governs them. .kube-linter.yaml has two exclusions whose reasons cite the DELETED backup-cronjob.yaml — reconcile (latest-tag likely dead; job-ttl reason -> migration Job which still sets ttlSecondsAfterFinished:3600). sync-secrets.yml hardcodes DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL in SEVEN sites (header, expected, extra-key filter, missing-key loop, two error messages, success echo) -> all become REDIS_PASSWORD; leave the slug strings alone. bootstrap_backups.py follows scripts/check_sops_encrypted.py conventions (module docstring, typed, argparse, main(argv)->int) — this batch only edits its docstring.
build_command_notes: Each FEAT runs the subset of gates relevant to its files; the convergence/integration step runs the whole suite. No DB/Redis is started — all unit tests are service-free; integration tests are not run here.
